page_title: INT 2-0 COM | Inter v Como 23/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Antonio Giua is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Alberto Cerri (Como) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90+2' It's a yellow card for Marcus Thuram (Inter).
90+2' 2 - 0 An excellent first touch by Marcus Thuram (Inter), who collects a splendid pass and from the edge of the box slams the ball into the top right corner!
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mehdi Taremi (Inter) replacing Lautaro Martinez.
89' Simone Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Henrikh Mkhitaryan is replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
88' It is time for a substitution. Alberto Cerri (Como) is on for Alieu Fadera.
87' Today's referee Antonio Giua rightly decides to book Luca Mazzitelli (Como) for his harsh tackle.
86' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
84' Tajon Buchanan (Inter) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.

82' Federico Barba (Como) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
80' Here comes a substitution. Federico Dimarco is given a rest as he is replaced by Tajon Buchanan (Inter).
80' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Inter.
79' A spell of possession for Inter in an attempt to control the game.
77' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a long ball in, but Pepe Reina comfortably gathers the ball.
74' Substitution. Luca Mazzitelli (Como) on for Andrea Belotti.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Federico Barba (Como) replaces Marc Oliver Kempf.
74' Simone Inzaghi has decided to substitute Nicolo Barella and he is replaced by Piotr Zielinski (Inter).
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Stefan de Vrij (Inter) is coming onto the pitch as Yann Bisseck cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' A loose ball is pounced on by Denzel Dumfries (Inter) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Pepe Reina is alert and makes a comfortable save.
71' Andrea Belotti (Como) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
69' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
68' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Lautaro Martinez (Inter) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ben Lhassine Kone (Como) comes onto the pitch so that Sergi Roberto can be given a rest.
65' Here is a change. Gabriel Strefezza is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Patrick Cutrone (Como).

65' What a chance that is! Yann Bisseck (Inter) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
64' The foul by Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Antonio Giua.
62' Nico Paz (Como) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Yann Sommer.
61' The ball is out of play. Como will have a chance to score from a corner.

60' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Antonio Giua has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Como win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
58' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 11:3.
55' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
54' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) sends a chip pass into the box, but Pepe Reina is quickest to intercept the ball.
52' Alieu Fadera (Como) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
50' Como are ruled offside.

48' 1 - 0 Hakan Calhanoglu takes over corner duties and expertly finds Carlos Augusto (Inter), who scores with a header that bounces up off the ground and goes into the bottom left corner. The score is now 1:0.
48' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
47' Marcus Thuram (Inter) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
44' Federico Dimarco (Inter) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
42' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
41' Inter hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
39' 6:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
37' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
35' Antonio Giua blows his whistle as Nico Paz (Como) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

33' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Denzel Dumfries (Inter), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
32' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yann Sommer intercepts the ball.
30' Carlos Augusto (Inter) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
28' The linesman signals a throw-in for Inter.
26' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Como are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
24' Yann Bisseck (Inter) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Antonio Giua ignores the protests.
22' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
20' Inter have been awarded a corner kick.

19' Antonio Giua blows his whistle and it's Denzel Dumfries (Inter) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. It's a free kick to Como, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
18' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
18' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
16' Como exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
14' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball has crossed the sideline. Como are taking a throw-in.
12' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
11' The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
9' Marcus Thuram (Inter) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
5' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) commits a rough challenge and Antonio Giua blows his whistle for a foul.
3' The free kick is taken by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter), but ball is cleared.
2' Antonio Giua interrupts the game. One of the players from Como won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Inter.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Inter will have the kick-off.
Antonio Giua is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
